errors.text_span: Die Länder am unteren Ende der Liste, wie Spanien, Luxemburg und Slowenien, zeigen kürzere Balken mit Gesamtwerten unter 1,5 % des BIP
errors.evidence: Spain and Slovenia's total bar lengths are closer to ~1.3-1.4%, but Luxembourg's total bar length is closer to ~1.7%, which is above 1.5%.

The reference description explicitly states the chart illustrates 'staatlichen Ausgaben' (government expenditures) as a percentage of GDP, while the machine-generated description specifies 'öffentlichen Ausgaben für Forschung und Entwicklung (F&E)' (public expenditures for R&D), which is not mentioned in the figure or reference.

The reference description mentions the black line represents '1,5 % über dem Referenzwert von 2021,' but the machine-generated description does not clarify the exact meaning of the black line relative to the 2021 reference value.
The reference description mentions the x-axis has intervals of 0.5, but the machine-generated description omits this detail, only mentioning markings at 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4%.
